versions.changelog:
Initial release of First-Aid Kit Auditor.

- Profiles household (people, kids, pets, adventure level, allergies/conditions) to generate personalized first-aid kit requirements.
- Audits your kit against a 46-item, evidence-based catalog; checks coverage, flags expired and expiring items.
- Computes overall coverage percentage; identifies missing, low-stock, and expired items with a prioritized shopping list.
- Registry-based tracking (JSON) for easy updates after incidents or over time.
- Clear CLI workflow for initialization, item registration, auditing, and shopping list generation.
